name: James Clinch Smith
bioAdditions: Son of Judge J. Lawrence Smith; through his father's line (Job 1st -> Job 2d -> Anna -> Richard 4th -> Richard 5th -> J. Lawrence -> James) he is John's 5th cousin 5 times removed, closer than the 6C5R on the site, and a descendant of John's own ancestor Job Smith. He inherited his father's homestead (Pelletreau 1898, S1); married the musician Bertha Ludington Barnes; witnessed the 1906 murder of his brother-in-law Stanford White; and died on the Titanic (Wikipedia, S2).
